meaning_in_context: To be severely beaten or injured.
To shoot or hit with great force.
To harass or trouble, often as a precursor to violence.
To strangle or cut off the breath of someone.
To strike a part of the body, usually the head, with a sharp, hard blow.
To overwhelm or defeat completely, often with physical force.
To slice or sever, as with a knife or by taking air out of a tire.
The ultimate consequence of violence.
To engage in physical combat.
A general but intense term for causing severe physical harm.
To suspend by the neck; also used in the context of hanging someone off a roof.
To strike with a blow.
To cause physical pain or injury.
To physically and verbally assault with overwhelming force.
To strike with the foot.
To cause the death of someone.
To wound or injure someone so that part of the body is permanently damaged.
To beat someone with a metal pipe.
To strike repeatedly with the fists.
To strike with a closed fist.
To inflict a penalty or suffering for an offense.
To render someone unconscious for a prolonged period through violence.
A direct euphemism for killing and burying someone.
To tear something apart violently (e.g., "rip a new asshole").
To take property from a person by using force or threats.
To treat someone in a physically aggressive way; to assault.
To pierce with a pointed weapon.
A euphemism for physically assaulting someone to enforce compliance.
To encircle a person with the intent to trap and assault them.
Used in the context of throwing someone off a roof.
A common slang term for murdering someone.
